reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: Section 9.4 grants Customer an unrestricted without-cause termination right over the Agreement or any Order Form, Section 29.4 fixes the notice at thirty days, and Sections 9.4/10.2 require refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period with no early-termination fee — this matches the preferred position (30 days' notice plus pro-rata refund).

No Vendor convenience right appears in the cited provisions, consistent with the preferred requirement that Vendor cannot walk away mid-term; the rationale's references to Sections 8.1–8.2 and 9.1–9.2 are supporting context and do not contradict the cited paragraphs.

Correctly no redline and no counterparty comment for a compliant finding; the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs and the deterministic check ('Customer convenience termination present') passes.

Rationale is accurate and appropriately scoped, noting the absence of penalties/exit charges rather than manufacturing a deviation; retaining this as internal compliance evidence is the right treatment.
